name: CASPER Data API
description: Static public data interface for CASPER. Sports, sectors and seasons are catalog-driven with no hard cap.
sector_model: A sector is a physical/local CASPER operating area. It is not inherently a country or administrative region. Each sector can maintain its own players, clubs, leagues, competitions and seasons. New sectors are added by creating data/sectors/{id}/ and listing them in sectors.json.
season_model: A season is discovered from seasons.json, sport/sector manifests, filenames (Season_{id}.csn) and CSN meta.s. Drop another Season_*.csn file and list it in the folder manifest to add a season.
notes: CASPER is hosted as a static site, so arbitrary HTTP query execution is handled by the API client rather than a server runtime.
CSN remains the canonical source for match and competition statistics; sectors.json is the authoritative registry for operating areas.
Club codes in player-registry.json resolve to human-readable names through each sector's clubs.json.
